ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT into as of the 30" day of May, 2013 between the NEW YORK CITY HOUSING AUTHORITY, a public benefit corporation established under the laws of the State of New York, having an office at 250 Broadway, New York, New York 10007 (the “Authority"); STANLEY SENIOR HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC., a not-for-profit corporation duly organized and existing under ArticleXI of the Private Housing Finance Law of the State of New York, having an office at c/o East Brooklyn Churches Sponsoring Committee, 551 Vandalia Avenue, 3"d Floor, Brooklyn, New York 11239 ("HDFC"); and STANLEY SENIOR L.P., a Committee, 551 Vandalia Avenue, 3"d Floor, Brooklyn, New York 11239 (the "Partnership' and collectively, with HDFC, the “Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Authority is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York, known as Block 4375,Lot 1 and Lot 50 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and commonly known as 670 Stanley Avenue (Lot 1); and 696 Stanley Avenue (Lot 50),as each is more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said lots being called, respectively, “Lot 1," and “Lot 50"; the steam plant located on Lot 50 is referred to herein as the “Authority's Lot 50 Building"; and any building that the Authority constructs or has constructed on Lot 1 hereafter is referred to herein as the “Authority's Lot 1 Building"); WHEREAS,pursuant to a Declaration of Interest and Nominee Agreement between the Partnership and HDFC dated as of the date hereof, the Partnership is the equitable and beneficial owner and HDFC is the record fee owner of certain land located in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York,known as Block 4375,Lot 70 on the Tax Map of the City of.New York, and commonly known as 890 Schenck Avenue, as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof ("Lot 70"); WHEREAS, a site plan of Block 4375 showing Lot 1, Lot 50 and Lot 70 is annexed hereto as Exhibit C); WHEREAS, Owner intends to demolish the existing improvements on Lot 70 (which improvements consist solely of a parking lot) to construct thereon a new seven (7) story, eighty (80) unit apartment building with supportive services for occupancy by low-income senior citizens (exclusive of one (1) additional unit for the superintendant) with a total zoning floor area of approximately Sixty-Eight Thousand Fifty (68,050) square feet as more particularly described in the zoning analysis attached hereto as Exhibit D (such new building, as the same may be altered, modified, improved or replaced from time to time permitted pursuant to this Agreement, is referred to herein as “Owner's Building"); WHEREAS, the Authority and Owner are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, in order to create a single zoning lot (the “Merged Zoning Lot") out of the land
